title: Project Feedback — Appendix A
intro: I reviewed the latest version of the appendix. Below are my notes, organized by section.

sections.title: Section 3.4 — Late Penalty (1% per day)
sections.body: I'd like to remove this clause entirely. In software development, delays happen: unexpected bugs, spec changes, dependencies on your side like approvals or assets. If there's a delay, I'll update you in advance. But an automatic deduction mechanism per day doesn't fit development work.

sections.title: Section 7.2 — Open Source Restriction
sections.body: Every modern application is built on Open Source libraries. React Native itself is Open Source, as is Firebase SDK and every npm package. This restriction effectively blocks all development work. I suggest replacing with: "Standard Open Source libraries are pre-approved. Only licenses that require source code disclosure (GPL, AGPL) require written approval."

sections.title: Portfolio Rights
sections.body: I'd like to add: "The service provider has the right to mention the project name in portfolios and resumes, with a brief description of the work, without exposing code or proprietary details."

sections.title: Approval Timeline
sections.body: I'd like to add: "The client will approve or provide written feedback within 5 business days. If no response is received, the deliverable is deemed approved."

sections.title: Items I Accept in v6
sections.body: These clauses were addressed and I'm satisfied with the current wording: Open Source permissive/copyleft distinction, 6-month non-compete narrowed to the specific domain, code in client repos, NDA signed.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.note: All prices exclude VAT where applicable.

availability: Immediately. I can start as soon as we sign.
closing: Looking forward to your response. Happy to hop on a quick call after you review this.
